description: This file contains Sass/SCSS functions and mixins related to Bootstrap styling, including utility functions for maps and color manipulations, and mixins for validating source order in maps.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to ensure a Sass map like grid breakpoints is in ascending order, issuing warnings if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to ensure the first value in a map (like grid breakpoints) starts at 0, issuing a warning if not.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Function to replace a substring with another string within a string, used for customizing SVG icon backgrounds.

methods.name: color-yiq
methods.description: Function to calculate color contrast using the YIQ algorithm, returning dark or light text color for accessibility.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a color from the `$colors` map based on a key.

methods.name: theme-color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a theme color from the `$theme-colors` map.

methods.name: gray
methods.description: Function to retrieve a gray shade from the `$grays` map.

methods.name: theme-color-level
methods.description: Function to generate a theme color shade at a specified level, blending with black or white.
